title: Low-frequency spectra of neutron star + OB supergiant binaries: Does wind density drive persistent and flaring modes of accretion?
question: What dominates the radio/millimeter emission of neutron star + OB supergiant binaries (stellar wind vs jet), and does wind density drive the SgXB (persistent) vs SFXT (flaring) dichotomy?

recipe.method: CLIC standard pipeline in GILDAS with manual inspection and re-runs, per observing date; output as UV-tables per target per side band
key_parameters: Calibration performed separately per observing date; baseline-based bandpass and amplitude for A configuration
Data dropped: 2024 March 19 segments 2 and 3 and all of 2024 March 14

recipe.goal: Image NOEMA data and measure 100 GHz flux densities
recipe.method: Average UV-tables, clean, measure RMS, fit a point source in the UV plane at the phase centre, merge sidebands for final flux
key_parameters: Clean region twice the primary beam FWHM, down to 2x expected RMS (2.5x with A configuration)
UV-plane point-source fit is the formal detection criterion; 3 sigma upper limits for non-detections

recipe.goal: Measure ALMA flux densities from pipeline images
recipe.method: Import pipeline FITS images into CASA, fit a 2D Gaussian with beam-fixed shape in the image plane, repeat on four sub-bands for detections
key_parameters: RMS in annulus of 15-30 pixels; detection if flux at least 3x local RMS
4U 1907+09 (offset from phase centre) measured manually at the source position in the 40 and 150 GHz images

recipe.goal: Calibrate, image and measure VLA 6 and 10 GHz flux densities
recipe.method: Manual CASA calibration, tclean at each frequency, imfit of a beam-shaped Gaussian; 3 sigma limits otherwise
key_parameters: Robustness varied per target and band to optimise sensitivity vs sidelobes
Flux error from RMS in a nearby source-free region

recipe.method: L_nu = 4 pi F_nu D^2 with errors propagated from flux and distance
assumptions: Distances from Table 1; 6.9 +/- 1.7 kpc adopted for IGR J18410-0535

recipe.method: MCMC fit of S = xi S0 (nu/nu0)^alpha; three versions (ALMA full bands, ALMA sub-bands, ALMA+VLA); 4U 1907+09 uses ALMA 40+150 GHz and NOEMA 100 GHz
key_parameters: S0 = 1 mJy, nu0 = 121.6 GHz (log-mean of the three ALMA centroid frequencies)
Parameter estimates reported as 16/84th percentile intervals
assumptions: Single power law; 4U 1700-37 10 GHz tentative point (207 +/- 87 microJy) shown but excluded from fits; NOEMA two-sub-band indices not used

recipe.goal: Search for short-term variability and an RRL; assess long-term variability
recipe.method: Light curves from uv-plane fits at 10 s and 1 min, constant-fit reduced chi-square, minimum detectable fractional variability; epoch-to-epoch comparison across campaigns
key_parameters: Light curves in 1-minute bins assessed with reduced chi-square of a constant fit
assumptions: Constant source; per-bin uncertainty scales with sqrt(N)

recipe.goal: Compare SFXT and SgXB millimeter luminosities and Fe K alpha EW
recipe.method: Rescale to 100 GHz luminosity and plot vs orbital period and vs weighted-average Fe K alpha EW; add literature SgXBs by extrapolating ATCA radio data to 100 GHz
key_parameters: Observed spectral index used for rescaling, otherwise alpha = 0.6
assumptions: Literature ATCA upper limits extrapolated to 100 GHz with alpha = 0.6; assumes low-frequency SED is wind dominated

recipe.goal: Compare millimeter Mdot/v_inf proxy with literature inner-wind estimates
recipe.method: Use 100 GHz luminosity as a proxy for Mdot/v_inf and compare to UV/optical/IR literature values
key_parameters: 100 GHz flux extrapolated from 150 GHz for ALMA targets using the measured alpha
assumptions: Smooth, spherically symmetric wind with mass conservation and constant velocity
Similar composition and wind temperature across targets

recipe.goal: Combine millimeter and bow shock constraints
recipe.method: Intersect the Mdot-v_inf permitted regions from the millimeter flux and from the bow shock stand-off distance
key_parameters: ISM density between 1 and 10 cm^-3 for 4U 1907+09 constraints
assumptions: Stand-off distances 0.57 pc and 0.89 pc from the literature

recipe.goal: Order-of-magnitude jet versus wind luminosity comparison
recipe.method: Compute analytic wind spectrum, wind capture fraction, X-ray luminosity, and jet luminosity from the Be/XRB L_X-L_R relation, as a function of Mdot
key_parameters: 1.4 Msun neutron star with assumed donor mass and orbital period, circular orbit
assumptions: Wind capture prescription of tejeda2025 and Be/XRB L_X-L_R relation extrapolated to SgXBs
